foreignQualification.feeBasis: Flat $150.00 filing fee for Form #972, Application of Foreign Limited Liability Company; credit-card payments add a $5.00 convenience fee.
foreignQualification.formName: Application of Foreign Limited Liability Company (Form #972)
foreignQualification.filedWith: Louisiana Secretary of State, Commercial Division
foreignQualification.ongoingObligationsNote: File the annual report ($30.00) and maintain a registered agent in Louisiana.

evidence.quote: Foreign limited liability companies Form Application of Foreign Limited Liability Company #972 $150
Enclose $150 filing fee Make remittance payable to Secretary of State Do Not Send Cash Commercial Division P. O. Box 94125 Baton Rouge, LA 70804-9125
the fees for the Commercial Division of the Secretary of State
Credit card payments are subject to an additional statutory convenience fee. $5
Certified Copies $15 Certified Copies with Amendments $25 Additional Certificates $20 Annual Reports $30 Foreign partnerships
The agent must be an individual resident in Louisiana, an individual attorney or a partnership which is authorized to practice law in Louisiana or a domestic or foreign corporation

notes: Form #972 is the paper application; filings are also accepted online through the Secretary of State's CORA portal. The fee schedule and the form both state the current $150 figure. Effective October 1, 2026, Act 921 raises this fee to $185 and the annual report fee from $30 to $35 (official fee-change schedule, static.sos.la.gov/shared/fee_changes_2026.pdf); this record states today's values. Root states.json carries the $30 annual report fee.
